correctness.rationale: Crosspolytope edge graph is complete on 2d vertices less antipodal matching. A plane with r vertices on one side cuts r(2d-r-1) edges. The invariant Crofton measure has directional-width bias; Gaussian radial independence converts the offset probability exactly to half-normal spacing expectation ratios. Telescoping gives tails; direct integration of all projected edges gives the exact mean. Binomial Gaussian upper order-statistic quantiles yield the beta exponent and quadratic rare tail; dominated convergence with an integrable Gaussian-power bound yields all positive moments. Independently coded weighted hyperplane sampling and literal original-edge crossing counts agreed in d=3,4,6; the exact d=3 constant and mean identity were checked. No finite computation is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete dimensional family of natural section-complexity distributions is determined, including the collision of top two edge-cut counts. The result exhibits a nondegenerate random polynomial exponent while proving all moments are dominated by a different, quantitatively sharp quadratic-complexity rare-event scale. This is more than a finite special-case calculation and supplies a structural geometric-probability benchmark.
